title: Everspin’s UNISYST MRAM Combines Code and Data Storage for Embedded Systems
summary: Everspin Technologies unveiled its UNISYST MRAM family at Embedded World 2026, introducing a unified code-and-data memory architecture designed to replace traditional NOR flash in embedded systems. Built on the PERSYST platform, UNISYST delivers high-speed persistent memory with up to 400 MB/s read bandwidth, faster writes, and significantly higher endurance, while simplifying system design by combining multiple memory functions into a single device.
body_markdown:
Everspin Technologies unveiled its UNISYST MRAM family at Embedded World 2026, introducing a unified code-and-data memory architecture designed to replace traditional NOR flash in embedded systems. Built on the PERSYST platform, UNISYST delivers high-speed persistent memory with up to 400 MB/s read bandwidth, faster writes, and significantly higher endurance, while simplifying system design by combining multiple memory functions into a single device.


Learn about how UNISYST strengthens MRAM’s role as a next-generation semiconductor memory solution for high-performance, mission-critical environments: https://www.electronics-lab.com/everspins-unisyst-mram-combines-code-and-data-storage-for-embedded-systems/
